r: Raw beef chopped by hand and seasoned with capers, gherkins, shallot and egg yolk.
Chop the beef with a knife as finely as you can. Keep it cold.
Chop the shallot, capers, gherkins and parsley.
Mix the beef with the mustard, Worcestershire sauce and chopped extras, then season with salt and pepper.
Shape into 4 portions and top each with an egg yolk.
Serve straight away, nice and cold, with chips or a salad.
With parmesan, pesto and sun-dried tomatoes.
A fresh Italian-style tartare, with basil and parmesan.
Chop the beef with a knife.
Mix the beef with the pesto, tomatoes, oil, salt and pepper.
Serve with the rocket and shavings of parmesan.
Seared for 30 seconds on each side.
The tartare that is just seared on the outside.
Chop the beef with a knife and mix with the shallot, capers, mustard and parsley.
Sear for 30 seconds on each side in very hot butter.|Pan|1
Very thin slices of raw beef with olive oil, lemon, parmesan and rocket.
Put the beef in the freezer for 1 h so it is easy to slice.
Cut it into the thinnest slices you can.
Drizzle with the oil and lemon juice, and season with salt and pepper.
Add the rocket, capers and shavings of parmesan.
A fresh salmon carpaccio with lime and dill.
Put the salmon in the freezer for 1 h.
Cut it into very thin slices and spread them out on plates.
Drizzle with the oil and lime juice.
Sprinkle with dill and pink peppercorns.
A fresh, light vegetarian carpaccio of courgettes.
Slice the courgettes into very thin ribbons with a peeler.
Drizzle with the oil and lemon juice, and season with salt and pepper.
Tom kha kai: chicken in a coconut broth with lemongrass and lime.
Bring 50 cl of water to a simmer with the stock cube, bruised lemongrass and sliced ginger.|Cooking|10
Add the coconut milk and the chicken in thin strips, and cook for 8 min.|Cooking|8
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook for 3 min.|Cooking|3
Off the heat, add the lime juice and fish sauce.
Tom yum: a spicy broth with prawns.
A hot and sour Thai soup with prawns.
Bring 1 litre of water to a simmer with the stock cube, lemongrass and chilli.|Cooking|10
Add the mushrooms and tomatoes, and cook for 3 min.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 min.|Cooking|3
Off the heat, add the lime juice and fish sauce.
A coconut and lemongrass soup with tofu.
Bring 50 cl of water to a simmer with the stock cube, lemongrass and ginger.|Cooking|10
Add the coconut milk, diced tofu and mushrooms.
Add the lime juice and soy sauce.
Small, thick, fluffy pancakes to top with cream and smoked salmon.
Mix the flour, baking powder, egg yolks, milk and melted butter.
Whisk the whites until stiff and fold them in.
Cook small rounds of batter for 1 min on each side in a buttered pan.|Pan|2
Top each blini with crème fraîche, salmon and dill.
Topped with a herby goat's cheese cream.
Party blinis with fresh goat's cheese.
Make the blini batter and cook the blinis.|Pan|2
Mix the fresh goat's cheese with the chopped chives.
Buckwheat blinis, with a more rustic flavour.
Dissolve the yeast in the lukewarm milk, then add the flours and egg yolks.
Fold in the whisked egg whites.
Cook the blinis for 1 min on each side and top with crème fraîche and salmon.|Pan|2
Soft honey spice bread flavoured with cinnamon, ginger and aniseed.
Heat the milk with the honey and sugar, without letting it boil.
Mix the flour, baking powder and spices, then add the honey milk and the egg.
Pour into a buttered loaf tin and bake for 1 h.|Oven|60
Wrap and leave for a day: it is even better.
A Christmas spice bread flavoured with orange.
Heat the milk with the honey and the orange zest.
Mix the flour, baking powder and spices, then add the milk, egg and orange juice.
Pour into a tin and bake for 1 h.|Oven|60
Egg-free, with just honey and milk.
Heat the milk with the honey.
Mix the flour, bicarbonate of soda and spices, then add the honey milk.
Pour into a tin and bake for 1 h.|Oven|60
A sweet shortcrust base with a rich dark chocolate ganache.
Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Blind bake the pastry for 20 min.|Oven|20
Heat the cream and pour it over the chopped chocolate.
Stir, then add the butter and the beaten egg.
Pour into the pastry case and bake for 10 min at 150 °C.|Oven|10
Leave to cool for at least 1 h.
With a layer of salted butter caramel.
A chocolate tart with a caramel centre.
Blind bake the pastry for 20 min at 180 °C.|Oven|20
Make a caramel with the sugar, add 10 cl of hot cream and the butter. Pour it into the pastry case.
Heat the rest of the cream and melt the chocolate in it.
Pour the ganache over the caramel and leave to set for 2 h in the fridge.
A biscuit base and a ganache.
A quick chocolate tart, no oven needed.
Crush the biscuits, mix with the melted butter and press into a tin.
Heat the cream and pour it over the chocolate.
Stir and pour over the base.
Leave to set for 2 h in the fridge.
A rolled sponge filled and covered with chocolate ganache, for Christmas dinner.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Whisk the eggs and sugar until the mixture triples in volume, then fold in the flour.
Spread on a tray lined with baking paper and bake for 8 min.|Oven|8
Roll up the warm sponge in a damp tea towel and leave to cool.
Heat the cream, pour it over the chocolate and leave to cool until the ganache thickens.
Unroll the sponge, spread with a third of the ganache, roll up and cover with the rest.
Draw lines with a fork and dust with icing sugar.
The yule log with chestnut cream, soft and melting.
Make the rolled sponge and bake for 8 min at 200 °C.|Oven|8
Roll it up in a damp tea towel.
Whip the cream and fold it into the chestnut cream.
Fill the sponge, roll it up and cover with melted chocolate.
With ice cream and biscuits, no baking.
An easy ice cream log to make the day before.
Line a loaf tin with cling film.
Layer softened vanilla ice cream, sponge fingers and chocolate ice cream.
Turn out and cover with melted chocolate just before serving.
A thick shortbread-style cake filled with custard and flavoured with almond.
Make the custard: heat the milk, whisk 2 eggs with 80 g of sugar and the cornflour, pour in the milk, then thicken over the heat. Leave to cool.|Cooking|5
Mix the butter and the rest of the sugar with 2 eggs, the flour, ground almonds and baking powder.
Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Press two thirds of the dough into a tin, add the custard and cover with the rest of the dough.
Brush with the last egg, mark with a fork and bake for 40 min.|Oven|40
The gâteau basque filled with black cherry jam.
Mix the butter and sugar with 2 eggs, the flour, ground almonds and baking powder. Chill for 1 h.
Press two thirds of the dough into a tin and cover with the jam.
Top with the rest of the dough, brush with egg and bake for 40 min.|Oven|40
The chocolate version of the gâteau basque.
Make a custard and stir in the chocolate at the end of cooking. Leave to cool.|Cooking|5
Make the shortbread dough and chill it for 1 h.
Assemble the cake: dough, custard, dough.
Brush with egg and bake for 40 min at 180 °C.|Oven|40
A simple cake full of soft apples, perfect for tea time.
Whisk the eggs and sugar, then add the flour, baking powder, melted butter and milk.
Peel the apples, cut them into pieces and add them to the batter.
Pour into a buttered tin and bake for 40 min.|Oven|40
Thin apple slices stacked with very little batter.
The cake of soft apple layers, with almost no batter.
Mix the eggs, sugar, flour, milk and melted butter.
Slice the apples very thinly and mix them into the batter.
Pack into a loaf tin and bake for 50 min.|Oven|50
The apple yoghurt cake, measured with the pot.
Mix the yoghurt, sugar, eggs, flour, baking powder and oil.
Pour into a tin and bake for 40 min.|Oven|40
A light, tangy lemon mousse to serve in glasses.
Whisk the yolks, sugar, cornflour, and the juice and zest of the lemons.
Thicken over a low heat, stirring, then leave to cool.|Cooking|5
Whip the cream and whisk the whites until stiff.
Gently fold the whipped cream, then the whites, into the lemon cream.
Spoon into glasses and chill for 3 h.
A tropical mousse with lime and coconut.
Mix the condensed milk with the juice and zest of the limes.
Whip the double cream and coconut cream together, both well chilled.
Gently fold into the lime mixture.
Spoon into glasses and chill for 3 h.
Mix the fromage blanc, icing sugar, and the juice and zest of the lemons.
Spoon into glasses and chill for 2 h.
